parameters.prompt: The exact spider-bodied demon lady in the reference lays eggs in place. From the resting pose she lowers her spider body close to the ground, the spider legs bending and spreading wide, the abdomen tilting down and pulsing once or twice, while her upper human body leans forward with both hands lowered toward the ground, holds this low crouched pose for a moment, then slowly rises on the spider legs and calmly returns to the exact original pose and holds it. The spider legs stay planted and do not walk. She stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Exactly two human arms and eight spider legs. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with clear margins at all times. Keep the same three-quarter left view, face, hair, upper clothing, spider body and leg colours. No eggs, webs, walking, turning, jumping, extra limbs, weapon, glow, energy, magic effects, smoke, mist, dust, rocks, cracks, particles, shadow or text. Motion beats: lower the body over the first second and a half, pulse the abdomen from one and a half to three and a half seconds, then rise and hold the original pose.
